Entire bird including tail and extended wing tips fit inside its own cell with generous at least10% padding on EVERY side, never touch neighboring cells. Match reference neutral pose exactly whenever neutral requested. No labels, grid, numbers, perch, floor, shadows, text or checkerboard.
